long_biography.plain_text:
At Nordic Asset Management, Kim Haugstrup Mikkelsen helped run a compact Copenhagen firm devoted to bond strategies. As an equity partner directing investments, he oversaw funds built around relative-value opportunities in Nordic government and mortgage markets. His approach drew on years of institutional trading and mortgage-risk experience, turning specialist market knowledge into an owner-managed investment career.

Strategic Capital gave Mikkelsen a vehicle for deploying capital through companies he controlled. It holds his majority position in listed Strategic Investments, whose portfolio mixes public and private Nordic businesses and seeks influence through board work. Outside finance, Mikkelsen established København Håndbold in 2013 and remained its principal backer for more than a decade. The commitment gives his public life a second dimension: sustained ownership of a professional women's sports club.
